centralePage.display: One tower, five cold feeders, [160] tonnes per hour.
centralePage.intro: Batch plant: every batch is dosed by weight — aggregates, filler, bitumen — then mixed and weighed out. The weighbridge prints a numbered ticket per load.
centralePage.controlRoomBody: Dosing, temperatures and weighing are run and logged from the control room. Every batch leaves a record: recipe, weights, temperature, timestamp.
centralePage.certifBody: ISO 9001: certification in progress. [Status to verify before publication.]

produitsPage.display: Every pavement layer has its mix.
produitsPage.intro: Mixes designed in the lab to the NM EN 13108 series. Values in brackets remain to be confirmed with the plant.

servicesPage.display: Logistics is part of the product.
servicesPage.intro: A compliant mix that arrives cold is a lost mix. Delivery, paving and testing are part of what the plant sells.

estimator.title: Delivery estimator
estimator.windowDays: {days, plural, one {# production day} other {# production days}}
estimator.footnote: Indicative estimate, confirmed by the planning desk.

qualitePage.display: A compliant mix is a measured mix.
qualitePage.intro: Every mix is designed before the first tonne; every delivered lot is tested. Tests follow the NM EN 12697 series.

temp.title: Temperature
temp.body: Recorded at production, at loading and at delivery. A tonne out of range does not leave.

pesee.title: Weighing
pesee.body: Dosing by weight at every batch; weighbridge on exit, numbered ticket per load.

trace.title: Traceability
trace.body: Recipe, weights, temperatures and timestamps archived per batch and per delivery note.

qualitePage.externalBody: Cross-testing with {org}. [Frequency and scope to specify.]
qualitePage.isoBody: Certification in progress. [Status to verify before publication.]

envPage.intro: A clean plant is proven with equipment and records, not adjectives.

filtre.title: Baghouse filter
filtre.body: Dryer-drum fumes pass through a baghouse filter; captured fines are re-injected as filler. [Emission values to publish once measured.]

rap.title: Reclaimed asphalt (RAP)
rap.body: [Incorporation rate to confirm.] Recycled millings replace virgin aggregate and part of the binder.

tiedes.title: Warm-mix asphalt
tiedes.body: Production lowered by about 30 °C: less fuel at the drum, less CO₂, same lab-validated performance.

eau.title: Water and noise

hse.title: Site safety
hse.body: Mandatory PPE, posted traffic plan, one-way truck flow, site speed limit.

lignechaude.title: One tonne's journey, from ambient to compaction.
